steps.say: Magic e sits at the end of a word. It does not make a sound.
It jumps over one letter and makes the vowel say its name.
Listen: kit has a short i. Kite has a long i.

figure.alt: A kite flying in the sky.

steps.say: It works with o and u too.
Some words end in e but stay short, like have and give. Learn them as tricky words.

check.prompt: Add magic e to pin. What word do you get?
hints: Magic e goes at the end.
It makes the i say its name.
check.explanation: Pin plus e is pine, like a pine tree.

options.why: That is the word before you add e.

check.prompt: Add magic e to hop. Write the new word.
hints: Magic e goes at the end.
The o will say its name.
Write hop, then add one letter.
